images.filename: Broad Street in Nevada City, California.jpg
images.caption: View of Broad Street with former New York Hotel in Nevada City, California, on May 31, 2020. The city was founded as “Nevada” by European immigrants in 1849, during the California Gold Rush. In 1850–51, it was the most important mining town in the state. In 1864, the word “City” was added to the name to relieve confusion with the nearby state of Nevada.The same view up Broad Street around 1856. Image by 19th century American studio photographer Julia Ann Rudolph
images.alt: View of Broad Street with former New York Hotel in Nevada City, California, on May 31, 2020. The city was founded as “Nevada” by European immigrants in 1849, during the California Gold Rush. In 1850–51, it was the most important mining town in the state. In 1864, the word “City” was added to the name to relieve confusion with the nearby state of Nevada.The same view up Broad Street around 1856. Image by 19th century American studio photographer Julia Ann Rudolph

images.filename: Broad Street Downtown Area in Nevada City, California.jpg
images.caption: Broad Street in Nevada City, California, on May 31, 2020. The historic buildings along Broad Street in the former mining town of Nevada City are part of the“Nevada City Downtown Historic District”. The city was founded as “Nevada” by European immigrants in 1849, during the California Gold Rush. In 1850–51, it was the most important mining town in the state. In 1864, the word “City” was added to the name to relieve confusion with the nearby state of Nevada.
images.alt: Broad Street in Nevada City, California, on May 31, 2020. images.filename: Interior view of Golden Era Cocktail Lounge in Nevada City.jpg
images.caption: Interior of the Cocktail Lounge "Golden Era" on Broad Street in Nevada City, California. Buildings at 309 Broad Street have housed bars and saloons since the California Gold Rush. Golden Era opened in 2015.
images.alt: Interior of the Cocktail Lounge "Golden Era" on Broad Street in Nevada City, California. Buildings at 309 Broad Street have housed bars and saloons since the California Gold Rush. Golden Era opened in 2015.

images.filename: Houses on Main Street, Nevada City.jpg
images.caption: Facades of houses on Main Street, looking up towards Church Street, in Nevada City, California, on May 31, 2020. The white building in the middle is historic Firehouse No. 1, which today houses a museum.
